title.en: The continuation condition on the root

statement.en: Stated on continuation relative to a class, the condition is that every occurrence is reached on every center's line under the class; held de se along a relation, it is exactly the root's condition at the one of that relation taken as the net.
statement.zh: 以相对于类之续而述，条件为：凡事皆为每一中心于此类下之线所及；依一关系 de se 而持，恰即以该关系为网、于其一下之根之条件。

laws.en: Given a net R, a class E and each standpoint's center, the condition along the net is that every occurrence is reached on every center's line under E, and in families that every occurrence lies in every center's family under E; what a line reaches lies in its family, so the first gives the second.
laws.zh: 给定网 R、类 E 与各立场之中心：沿网之条件为凡事皆在每一中心于 E 下之线所及；族之条件为凡事皆在每一中心于 E 下之族中；线之所及皆在其族，故前者蕴族者。

laws.en: Under a coarser class every family holds the finer class's family, and the condition along the net or in families at a class gives it at every coarser class.
laws.zh: 较粗之类下，每一族含较细之类之族；条件于一类下（沿网或族）成立，则于每一较粗之类下亦成立。

laws.en: Lying within a closure along a relation is being reached on a line under the one of that relation; so the condition held de se along a relation is exactly the root's condition at the one of that relation taken as the net, and on the own-closure reading of claims living significance follows, with self-significance, both neutralities and, where something lives, a seed.
laws.zh: 在一关系之闭包内，即在该关系之一下之线所及；故依一关系 de se 而持之条件，恰即以该关系为网、于其一下之根之条件；以自闭包读断言者，生之有义由之，并自之有义、二中立，有生则有种。

laws.en: Along a net with no cycle, where the condition holds, every standpoint has the same center: two centers each reached from the other would lie on a cycle, and nothing conditions that center. On a net going forward in time this comes from the condition's asking that nothing other than the center lie at or before its step; over what comes after, two centers can meet it.
laws.zh: 无环之网中，此条件成立处，诸立场之中心皆同：二中心互相所及则成环，且无物为此中心之缘。于按时间向前之网，此出于条件要求中心之步及其前除中心外无物；就其后者而言，两个中心可满足之。

hypotheses.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier, relation and class; the class and the standpoints' centers supplied, not read off the net; for the de se instance a relation on formations taken as the net; for living significance, a reading of claims through the own closure (reads); for the one-center laws, a net with no cycle.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：对一切载体、关系与类；各立场之中心给定；世界之例设形成上之一关系与有义之 de se 自闭包之读；生之有义设 Valuation.premises_of_unrestricted 之断言之读。

does_not_show.en: That any actual net meets the condition at any class, which class a center's own line runs under, or which occurrences are centers.
does_not_show.zh: 实有之网于某类下满足此条件，中心之自线在何类下，或何事为中心。

does_not_show.en: That the relations a self is drawn along run with 缘: feeding and influence run to conditions, so read along them the condition reaches what one depends on, not what follows.
does_not_show.zh: 自所沿之关系与缘同向：馈与影响向条件而行，沿之读，条件及所依者，非所随者。

does_not_show.en: The free significance parameter of the condition, on the root: it is not lifted, and its non-entailment holds by construction of that parameter.
does_not_show.zh: 条件之自由之有义参数于根上：未提升，其不蕴涵由该参数之构造而成立。

does_not_show.en: That anyone must hold the condition; where it holds de se, with admission decided, self-concern ranks every extension between two level paths whose admissions fit in a finite list, not the converse (self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition).
does_not_show.zh: 任何人须持此条件；条件从己成立处，接纳可判定，自关切排定所接纳之项容于一有限列表的二层径间之每一扩展，不推出其逆（self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition）。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261023T220231.427406Z): Becoming.GrammarScope, 30 theorems in 37 declarations, every declaration with an empty axiom report; the checker verifies core purity. This record cites 14 of them. Author review in study section 392.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261023T220231.427406Z）：Becoming.GrammarScope，37 项声明中 30 条定理，公理报告皆空；检查器并核对核心纯净。本记录引其中 14 项。作者审查见研究第 392 节。

next_delta.en: Beyond the three stated at the own-closure reading on a web's level paths (U3), the chapter's other theorems that take the condition stated as instances through the root's; the condition for many centers in families; which class a center's own line runs under, argued or modelled.
next_delta.zh: 除于网之水平路径上、自闭包读下所述之三条（U3）外，本章以条件为前提之其他定理，经根之条件述为其例；多中心之族之条件；中心之自线在何类下，论证或建模。

correspondence.en: SW §3's structural reading (what counts for a center is what lies within its reach along a relation) carried to the root; the source's "for anything, its continuation into the future has significance" read as "every occurrence is reached on every center's line": nothing lies outside each center's reach (续无外).
correspondence.zh: SW §3 之结构之读（中心之所计，在其沿一关系所及之内者）移于根上；来源之「凡物之续入未来皆有义」读为「凡事皆为每一中心之线所及」：无物在每一中心所及之外（续无外）。

aliases: The continuation condition on the root

detail.en: Which class a center's own line runs under, and when the dynamics fix it.
detail.zh: 中心之自线在何类下，及动力何时定之。

history.en: 24 October 2026: added (GS2), from the review of the root against its two source texts, with SW's proposal 3 and PW's item 3; study section 392.
history.zh: 2026年10月24日：新增（GS2），出自根与其二篇来源之对照审查，并取 SW 之提议三与 PW 之第三项；研究第 392 节。

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item DF (study section 418): the retired label S0 in the third law reads self-significance; the law is unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月25日，工作板条目 DF（研究第 418 节）：第三条律英文中的退役标签 S0 改为自身意义；律不变。

history.en: 1 November 2026, board item OU7 (study section 492): the correspondence's English reading of the source restated so that its quantifiers match the definition of «续无外» (every center, every occurrence), as GrammarScope's docstrings now word it (the grammar's owner's patches/owner/05); the Chinese 凡中心之续无外 stands, and nothing proved changes. Nothing else the record states changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 OU7（研究第 492 节）：对应中来源之英文之读重述，使其量词合于 «续无外» 之定义（每一中心、每一事），与 GrammarScope 之文档今之所言同（文法之主人之 patches/owner/05）；中文「凡中心之续无外」不变，所证无改变。记录所述余无改变。

history.en: 2 November 2026, board item PF3: corrected to say C gives order in general alone, since 07 §4.4's theorem has an order rising with one's own continuation rank one case with no C; no law, premise or proof changes.
history.zh: 2026年11月2日，看板条目 PF3：更正为 C 给出次序，一般而言唯有 C，因为 07 §4.4 的定理表明，一个随自身延续上升的次序不靠 C 也排出一种情形；没有定律、前提或证明改变。

history.en: 7 November 2026, board item LM1: a reader of LM found this said C orders alone, where a ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place (07 §4.4); corrected. No law, premise or proof changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月7日，工作板条目 LM1：LM 之读者指出此处谓唯 C 定序，而对进程的排序需要 C 或一个代替它的前提（07 §4.4）；已更正。诸律、前提与证明皆不变。

history.en: 10 November 2026, AG review, seventh pass (on Ren's messages 9 to 12 of 9 November 2026, sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md, and the sixth pass's two cold readings): the statement and correspondence say the condition as reach, every occurrence reached on every center's line, nothing outside each center's reach, and the structural reading as what lies within a center's reach along a relation, in place of 'lies within every center's continuing' and 'within its continuing'; the one-center law says that on a net with no cycle, where the condition holds, every standpoint has the same center; the Chinese renders de se as 从己. No declaration or proof changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月10日，AG 审查第七轮（据 Ren 2026 年 11 月 9 日之第 9 至 12 条，sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md，及第六轮两份冷读）：陈述与对应以所及言条件：凡事皆为每一中心之线所及，无物在每一中心所及之外，结构之读言中心之所计在其沿一关系所及之内，以代「皆在每一中心之续中」与「在其沿一关系之续中」；一中心之律改言：无环之网中，此条件成立处，诸立场之中心皆同；中文以「从己」译 de se。声明与证明皆不变。

history.en: 10 November 2026, AG eighth pass: "one way" no longer labels the direction of the path result (the converse is not shown), and decided admission is named; its home section says the one-center law with what the bound counts on a net going forward in time (what-the-one-center-bound-counts). No law changed (on the seventh pass's two cold readings and Ren's messages 9 to 12, sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md).
history.zh: 2026年11月10日，AG 第八轮：路径之果之方向不再以「单向」标之（其逆未证），并写明接纳可判定；其所在之节以按时间向前之网上此界所计者述一中心之律（what-the-one-center-bound-counts）。诸律不变（据第七轮两份冷读与 Ren 之第 9 至 12 条，sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md）。

history.en: 10 November 2026, AG ninth pass: the one-center law adds what it counts on a net going forward in time (nothing other than the center at or before its step; over what comes after two centers can meet the condition), as what-the-one-center-bound-counts proves. No law or proof changed (on the eighth pass's critic, sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md).
history.zh: 2026年11月10日，AG 第九轮：一中心之律补言其于按时间向前之网所计者（中心之步及其前除中心外无物；就其后者而言两个中心可满足条件），如 what-the-one-center-bound-counts 所证。诸律与证明不变（据第八轮评者，sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md）。
